verdict.rationale: The RTX 5090 is a discrete graphics card, so in-product AI insights and suggestions drawn from a user's data are a category error for this kind of product. The AI features in the evidence (DLSS frame generation, neural rendering, Tensor Core acceleration) generate pixels or accelerate workloads; none analyzes user data to surface insights. Nothing in the pack shows the product shipping such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
